 DAYTON, Ohio (WKEF) -- Medicare open enrollment season can bring an increase in phone calls, junk mail, and online advertisements promising extra benefits. 
 Chris Curtis with Medicare Planning of Dayton joined Good Day Dayton to explain how to spot potential Medicare scams, what warning signs to watch for, and how to protect personal Medicare information.
